messages:
Zoe: quick heads-up  clicking the optimizer guide's sidebar I hit a 404 on the quantization deep-dive link (/guides/optimizer/quantization#int8-path).
Tyler: thanks, which environment? staging or prod?
Zoe: staging preview. looks like the fragment id changed to '#int8-execution' after the restructure.
Docs-bot: link-checker: broken fragment detected in /guides/optimizer/quantization (staging). filed DOCS-2044.
Mina: that was my refactor. I renamed the header for clarity but forgot to update the TOC. small fix.
Zoe: I'll open a tiny PR to add an HTML anchor alias and update the sidebar entry. will include a one-line changelog frontmatter.
Tyler: ping me for review. QA wants a quick preview assertion too.
Zoe: PR opened: https://git.internal.redwood.io/docs/pr/8044  adds <!-- anchor: int8-path --> above heading, updates sidebar, and a preview test. local commands I ran:
```bash
git checkout -b fix/quant-anchor
echo "<!-- anchor: int8-path -->" | sed -i '1i' content/guides/optimizer/quantization.md
git commit -am "docs: add anchor alias for int8 quantization link"
git push origin fix/quant-anchor
```
QA: quick smoke  preview shows fragment resolves. tiny suggestion: include "changelog: fix quant anchor" in frontmatter so release notes capture it.
Zoe: added changelog line and updated PR. Tyler, ready for review.
Tyler: LGTM, merging once CI passes.
Docs-bot: PR 8044 merged by Tyler. staging preview rebuilt. DOCS-2044 marked resolved.
Zoe: confirmed staging link works. thanks all for the quick turnaround! :sparkles:
